agent_messages.text: I’ll read the pinned goal, audits, and latest worker evidence, then reconcile the timed-out run before choosing the next proof step. I’ll record new work under unique research and evidence paths.

The target and audits preserve raw coefficients, zeros, all three directions, and both endpoints. The timed-out worker left substantial third-column proof artifacts; I’ll check its logs and validation receipts before deciding which results can be reused. Shell here-documents failed because the sandbox denied temporary-file creation, so I’ll use direct file edits and Python arguments.

Worker 121 timed out after its finalization command succeeded. All 1,353 recorded artifacts match their hashes; the run left 235 compiled modules, but only 23 had separate replay receipts. I’ll preserve those results and attempt the remaining source regions in new files, aiming for a third-column theorem for every source with numerator at least 7.

The first certificate has compiled, but the remaining certificates are taking long enough that the full third-column result may exceed this run’s budget. I’ll prioritize a complete extension from the half-remainder region to the one-third-remainder region, then use the remaining time for source transport and validation.

The exact experiment passed 79,633 coefficient comparisons and 79,363 adjacent inequalities across 135 fractions in the newly targeted region, retaining 64,040 zeros. These are finite checks only. Lean is checking the universal coefficient inequalities; the source and residual candidates retain all natural indices and the original polygon guards.

Lean has checked the equality-boundary lemma: for reduced labels with a≥7, a=3(b mod a) is impossible. That lets the proposed result use the inclusive condition a≤3(b mod a). The source-region certificates are still compiling; the connected source theorem and residual equivalence remain unvalidated.

The selected builds have passed so far. The source-count calculation also shows that two parameter cases are redundant for reduced fractions. If time permits after the one-third region, I’ll use that reduction to attempt the remaining smaller-remainder region. Neither result is established until its source theorem passes.

The one-third-region certificates are nearing completion. I also found a validation detail worth making explicit: Lean’s replay routine can skip theorem bodies already present in its import environment. I’ve added a local check that rejects such pre-imported mathematical declarations before replay; the new validation receipts will record that check.

The one-third-region build is close to finishing, and the new replay-isolation check has passed on the boundary lemma. Lean also checked that the remaining high source region needs only two parameter cases. I’ll now focus on connecting and validating the current region’s source theorem and exact residual.

The first axiom audit passed: all 213 inspected theorem closures use only the permitted axioms. The selected source-region builds are almost finished, with no failures in that queue so far. Kernel replay is running before I rely on the connected raw-coefficient theorem.

The raw third-column source theorem and exact residual equivalence have compiled. One replay batch hit an overly broad isolation check on an inherited, compiler-generated equation theorem. I’ve narrowed that check to this run’s declared mathematical names and will repeat validation with the revised checker. Full Conjecture 6.3 remains unresolved.

The expanded axiom audit passed for all 109 compiled mathematical modules, including the source theorem and residual equivalence. The theorem covers raw third-column inequalities for a≥7 and a≤3(b mod a), without a denominator or index bound. Final replay is underway; the smaller-remainder region, small numerators, and other unresolved lines remain in the residual.

The source bounds, raw third-column theorem, and exact residual equivalence have now passed kernel replay with the declaration-isolation check. I’m finishing replay of the coefficient certificates and checking that inherited files, the pinned root, and the contract remain unchanged.

All 109 compiled mathematical modules have now passed the axiom audit and kernel replay, including the new declaration-isolation check. I’ll finish the preservation manifest and record the remaining obligations. This establishes the expanded third-column region; completion remains null for the full pinned conjecture.
